replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have always found mathematics quite intimidating. While I appreciate its importance in economics, my own background means I never felt comfortable diving deep into it. Math feels more like a specialized language for others, not something I naturally speak. My father had a PhD and used these skills daily, but those were his battles, not mine.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. The moment numbers start flying or formulas appear on the page, my stomach turns. I dread it. It's not that I'm incapable; it feels more like stepping into a high school classroom where everyone else is talking Greek to me. It triggers old insecurities.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. My phone and internet access for such things are limited. Even if I had them, I would be skeptical about trusting a machine with something as cold and rigid as math. I prefer asking my grandchildren or using old textbooks instead.
